name: ABR Glyph-Volume Hybrid Visualization
definition: A hybrid visualization technique for Diffusion-Tensor MRI data that combines volume rendering for anatomical context with sparsely sampled, texture-encoded glyphs and oriented ellipsoids to represent crossing fibers and microstructural parameters.
summary: ABR Glyph-Volume Hybrid Visualization combines volume rendering with sparse glyphs and a magic lens to resolve occlusion in DT-MRI data by encoding fiber orientation via texture rather than color.
